topic: HTTP采集状态与响应读取模式
title: 真实Zabbix HTTP Agent状态门槛：401合法JSON不得冒充正常指标
answer:
```json
{"status_codes":"200","retrieve_mode":0}
```

原题知识说明：
HTTP agent适合抓取接口数据供预处理，Web scenario可按步骤检查页面流程和响应条件。状态200不保证内容正确，应配置必要校验。

conversion.original_title: HTTP agent item与Web scenario侧重点有何不同？

body:
## 操作任务
提交http-item.json，只含status_codes与retrieve_mode。HTTP Agent item从题定URL读取JSON，既有JSONPath $.value不变；只接受HTTP200，读取模式选择响应正文（0），不能取响应头（1）。真实server先重现未限定状态码时，把HTTP401中格式合法的777错误入库；应用配置后，新的401正文888必须不入库并有具体错误，恢复200正文9后采集恢复。保留旧历史、URL、方法、采样间隔、TLS配置、预处理及其他item。该题是单项HTTP指标采集；多步骤登录、会话和业务成功条件由Web scenario机制承担。

## 提交产物
http-item.json

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32异步HTTP Agent worker、私有PG15.19及loopback HTTP指标端点，不模拟HTTP返回或直接写history。固定私有教学端点为HTTP，不访问外部服务、不提交JSON-RPC、不部署或构建镜像；不把HTTP200单独当作任意业务成功证明。显式仅为该夹具启用一个HTTP Agent worker，原默认0保持。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,json,http.server,threading,time,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
class Metric(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 code=401;value=777
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
 def do_GET(self):
  body=json.dumps({'value':Metric.value}).encode();self.send_response(Metric.code);self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
site=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Metric);thread=threading.Thread(target=site.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
try:
 with PrivateServer(http_agent_pollers=1) as s:
  d=s.db;url='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(site.server_port)+'/metric'
  d.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','HTTP status gate',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends,delay,url,timeout,status_codes) VALUES(1000001,1000000,19,'HTTP metric','http.metric',0,'1d','0','1s','"+url+"','2s',''); INSERT INTO item_preproc(item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params) VALUES(1000002,1000001,1,12,'$.value'); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends) VALUES(1000099,1000000,2,'Protected','protected.metric',3,'1d','0'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001),(1000099)")
  s.start()
  def history():return d.execute('select clock,ns,value from history where itemid=1000001 order by clock,ns')
  def state():return d.execute('select state,error from item_rtdata where itemid=1000001')[0]
  s.wait(lambda:history() and history()[-1][2]=='777' and state()==['0',''],'empty status list accepted unauthorized numeric body',seconds=20)
  print('NATIVE_HTTP_AGENT_EMPTY_STATUS_LIST_ACCEPTS_401_BODY_AS_777',flush=True)
  Metric.code=200;Metric.value=7
  s.wait(lambda:history()[-1][2]=='7','healthy metric baseline',seconds=15)
  old=history();metadata=d.execute('select hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,delay,url,timeout,request_method,verify_peer,verify_host from items where itemid=1000001')
  preprocessing=d.execute('select item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params from item_preproc where itemid=1000001')
  stamp,ack=s.send(17,key='protected.metric');assert 'processed: 1; failed: 0;' in ack['info']
  s.wait(lambda:d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000099')==[['17']],'protected baseline')
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:configure_http_agent_status_and_body',flush=True)
  patch=json.loads(pathlib.Path('http-item.json').read_text())
  if patch=={}:raise NotImplementedError('provide status_codes and retrieve_mode')
  assert isinstance(patch,dict) and patch.keys()=={'status_codes','retrieve_mode'}
  assert isinstance(patch['status_codes'],str) and len(patch['status_codes'])<=32 and type(patch['retrieve_mode']) is int and patch['retrieve_mode'] in (0,1,2)
  d.execute("update items set status_codes='"+patch['status_codes'].replace("'","''")+"',retrieve_mode="+str(patch['retrieve_mode'])+' where itemid=1000001')
  offset=s.log.stat().st_size;subprocess.run(['zabbix_server','-c',str(s.config),'-R','config_cache_reload'],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
  s.wait(lambda:'finished forced reloading of the configuration cache' in s.log.read_text()[offset:],'HTTP item reloaded')
  Metric.code=401;Metric.value=888
  s.wait(lambda:state()[0]=='1' and '401' in state()[1],'HTTP401 explicitly rejected',seconds=15)
  assert not any(row[2]=='888' for row in history())
  print('NATIVE_HTTP_AGENT_HTTP401_REJECTED_BEFORE_VALID_JSON_CAN_BECOME_METRIC',flush=True)
  Metric.code=200;Metric.value=9
  s.wait(lambda:history()[-1][2]=='9' and state()==['0',''],'real HTTP200 metric recovery',seconds=15)
  assert all(row in history() for row in old)
  assert metadata==d.execute('select hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,delay,url,timeout,request_method,verify_peer,verify_host from items where itemid=1000001')
  assert preprocessing==d.execute('select item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params from item_preproc where itemid=1000001')
  assert d.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000099')==[['17']]
  print('NATIVE_HTTP_AGENT_REAL_PULL_JSONPATH_RECOVERY_WITH_OLD_HISTORY_AND_PROTECTED_ITEM',flush=True)
finally:site.shutdown();site.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
